summary: Iteration 10 regression for Phase 1-3 comprehensive update (unified date filters, real hard-delete safety, dashboard sales_today Yemen TZ, WhatsApp URLs, PWA, admin /mof30 gating, delete-button UI). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration10_phase123.py with 13 tests covering all 12 review scenarios — ALL 13 PASS. Frontend playwright script confirms routing (/login and /mof both redirect to /, /mof30 shows login), MOFEED login lands on /dashboard, and delete buttons render on Customers/Suppliers/Sales/Receipts pages with the expected data-testid prefixes (cust-delete-*, sup-delete-*, sale-delete-*, rec-delete-*). PublicOrder pre-login header (po-header-welcome) is present.

issues: React dev warning in console: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' from Login component. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up (likely a setState during render inside Login).

action_items: Optional: fix React warning in Login.jsx (setState-in-render). Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3593 lines — still needs to be split into modules (repeat from iter 9).
delete_customer / delete_supplier compute counts via 4 separate count_documents calls; consider a single aggregation for large datasets.

delete_sale / delete_purchase do not run in a transaction — a mid-way failure between balance-reversal and doc removal could leave the DB in an inconsistent state. Consider wrapping in a Mongo session with_transaction, or at minimum an idempotent guard.
There is no GET /api/customers/{id} endpoint — only /statement. Adding one would simplify UI polling after mutations.
seed_data_creation: All test-created customers/suppliers/sales/purchases/receipts prefixed with TEST_ and cleaned up in-line (best-effort — a customer that accrued ledger history intentionally remains as the delete-refuse test explicitly verifies the refuse path).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 12 review scenarios verified. Backend endpoints exercised: POST/DELETE /customers, POST/DELETE /suppliers, POST/DELETE /sales, POST/DELETE /purchases, POST/DELETE /receipts, POST /customers/{id}/password, POST /customers/{id}/unbind-device, POST /public-blocks/{phone}/unblock, GET /reports/dashboard, GET /manifest.json, GET /service-worker.js, POST /auth/login. Audit-log lookup uses GET /api/audit (NOT /api/audit-logs). There is no GET /customers/{id} — use list-and-filter. Frontend: /login and /mof correctly caught by React catch-all Navigate to='/'. Delete buttons found: Customers=34, Suppliers=6, Sales=68, Receipts=2. Console has one non-blocking React 'setState-in-render' warning on Login.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration. The 5 initial pytest failures were purely test-side issues (test called GET /customers/{id} which does not exist, and audit URL was /audit-logs instead of /audit). Fixed the test file and all 13 tests now pass.
